import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 1000007;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static int p, k;
    static int[] v = new int[N];
    static int[] num = new int[N];

    static void dfs(int x, int st) {
        int cnt = 1;
        while ((long) k * x % p != st) {
            x = (int)((long) k * x % p);
            v[x] = 1;
            cnt++;
        }
        num[cnt]++;
    }

    static boolean check(int x) {
        for (int i = 2; i * i <= x; i++) {
            if (x % i == 0) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        p = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        sc.close();

        if (k == 0) {
            long ans = 1;
            for (int i = 1; i < p; i++) {
                ans = ans * p % MOD;
            }
            System.out.println((int) ans);
            return;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
            if (v[i] == 0) dfs(i, i);
        }

        ArrayList<Integer> vec = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= p; i++) {
            if (num[i] != 0) vec.add(i);
        }

        long ans = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.size(); i++) {
            long t = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < vec.size() && (long) vec.get(j) * vec.get(j) <= vec.get(i); j++) {
                if (vec.get(i) % vec.get(j) == 0) {
                    int a = vec.get(i) / vec.get(j);
                    int b = vec.get(j);
                    t += (long) a * num[a];
                    if (a != b) t += (long) b * num[b];
                    t %= MOD;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < num[vec.get(i)]; j++) {
                ans = ans * t % MOD;
            }
        }
        System.out.println((int) ans);
    }
}
